requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the front position lamps shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Confirm a front side-marker lamp is installed and check visibility over 45° outwards to 45° inwards (20° inwards below H plane if below 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1., and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the front position lamps shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check visibility over 15° above and below horizontal (5° downward if below 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.9.5.2. is used, to be considered visible, the front position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm2, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light being excluded.
requirements.test_case: Measure unobstructed projected apparent surface (excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector area) at the boundary angles; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm2.

requirements.text: The front position lamps shall be oriented forwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp reference axis; pass if directed forwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the front position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11., except that if a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator the electrical connection of the front position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.test_case: Functionally test switching of the front position lamps against paragraph 5.11, and with direction indicator operating if reciprocally incorporated; pass if behaviour complies.

requirements.text: The number of front retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No.150.
requirements.test_case: Count the front retro-reflectors and check each carries an R3 (02+) or R150 Class IA/IB approval mark; pass if two approved devices are fitted.

requirements.text: The point on the illuminating surface of the front retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the distance from the outermost point of the illuminating surface to the extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The front retro-reflectors shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm).
requirements.test_case: Measure illuminating surface heights on the unladen vehicle; pass if lowest ≥ 250 mm and highest ≤ 900 mm (≤ 1,500 mm if justified by bodywork).

requirements.text: The front retro-reflectors shall be positioned in length at the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Visually verify the retro-reflectors are located at the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The front retro-reflectors shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle/CAD that the illuminating surface is unobstructed over 30° inwards and outwards.

requirements.text: The front retro-reflectors shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below the horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check unobstructed visibility 10° up and 10° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm per 5.8.1).

requirements.text: The front retro-reflectors shall be oriented towards the front.
requirements.test_case: Visually verify the reference axis of the retro-reflectors faces forwards.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflectors shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check approval marking of each side retro-reflector for R3 (02+) or R150 Class IA/IB.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflectors shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively or if the presence of the device is not mandatory according to paragraph 6.17.1.).
requirements.test_case: Measure illuminating surface heights on the unladen vehicle; pass if within 250 mm to the applicable upper limit.

requirements.text: For motor vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m, it shall be sufficient to have one side retro-reflector fitted within the first third and/or one within the last third of the vehicle length.
requirements.test_case: Measure longitudinal position of the side retro-reflector; pass if within the first third of vehicle length.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflectors shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° to the front and to the rear.
requirements.test_case: Check unobstructed visibility of the illuminating surface 45° forwards and rearwards.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflectors shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below the horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check unobstructed visibility 10° up and 10° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The side retro-reflectors shall be oriented towards the side.
requirements.test_case: Visually verify the reference axis faces sideways.

requirements.text: On M1 and N1 category vehicles less than 6 m in length, side-marker lamps shall be used, if they supplement the reduced geometric visibility requirements of front position lamps conforming to paragraph 6.9.5.2. and rear position lamps conforming to paragraph 6.10.5.2.
requirements.test_case: Check whether front position lamps use the reduced geometric visibility of 6.9.5.2; if so verify side-marker lamps are fitted.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall be optional on all other vehicles, and the SM1 or SM2 types of side-marker lamps may be used.
requirements.test_case: Verify the side-marker lamp is of type SM1 or SM2 per its approval marking.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 91, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp carries a valid UN R91 or UN R148 approval mark.

requirements.text: The minimum number of side-marker lamps per side shall be such that the rules for longitudinal positioning are complied with.
requirements.test_case: Count side-marker lamps per side and compare with the longitudinal positioning rules.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).
requirements.test_case: Measure apparent surface heights on the unladen vehicle; pass if ≥ 250 mm and ≤ 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: In length, at least one side-marker lamp shall be fitted to the middle third of the vehicle, the foremost side-marker lamp being not further than 3 m (4 m for semi-trailers) from the front, except that for vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m and for chassis-cabs it is sufficient to have one side-marker lamp fitted within the first third and/or within the last third of the vehicle length, and for M1 vehicles the length of which exceeds 6 m but does not exceed 7 m it is sufficient to have one side-marker lamp fitted not further than 3 m from the front and one within the last third of the vehicle length.
requirements.test_case: Measure the longitudinal position of the side-marker lamp on the vehicle against vehicle length and verify it lies within the permitted third/distance from the front.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° to the front and to the rear, except that for vehicles on which the installation of the side-marker lamps is optional this value can be reduced to 30°.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed lamp that the apparent surface is visible over 45° (or 30° where optional) to the front and to the rear in the horizontal plane.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height and verify the apparent surface is visible 10° above and 10° (or 5° if below 750 mm) below the horizontal.

requirements.text: If the vehicle is equipped with side-marker lamps used to supplement the reduced geometric visibility of front and rear direction indicator lamps conforming to paragraph 6.5.5.2. and/or position lamps conforming to paragraphs 6.9.5.2. and 6.10.5.2., the horizontal angles of geometric visibility of the side-marker lamps shall be 45° towards the front and rear ends of the vehicle and 30° towards the centre of the vehicle (see the figure in paragraph 6.5.5.2.).
requirements.test_case: Verify geometric visibility of the side-marker lamp is 45° towards the vehicle end and 30° towards the vehicle centre.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall be oriented towards the side.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp and verify its reference axis points laterally outwards.

requirements.text: On M1 and N1 category vehicles less than 6 m in length amber side-marker lamps may be wired to flash, provided that this flashing is in phase and at the same frequency with the direction-indicator lamps at the same side of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Activate the direction indicator and verify the amber side-marker lamp flashes in phase and at the same frequency as the direction-indicator lamps on the same side.

requirements.text: If a tell-tale for the side-marker lamps exists, its function shall be carried out by the tell-tale required for the front and rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that any side-marker tell-tale is the one used for front and rear position lamps.

requirements.text: Motor vehicles shall be equipped with daytime running lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and verify daytime running lamps are fitted.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall be equipped with two daytime running lamps, type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 87, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Count the daytime running lamps and verify each carries a UN R87 or UN R148 approval mark.

requirements.text: In width, the distance between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces of the daytime running lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall not be less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance between inner edges of the DRL apparent surfaces and verify it is at least 600 mm (400 mm if vehicle width < 1,300 mm).

requirements.text: The daytime running lamps shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the DRL apparent surface above ground and verify it is between 250 mm and 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: In length, the daytime running lamps shall be at the front of the vehicle; this requirement shall be deemed to be satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the DRL is mounted at the vehicle front and check from the driver's seat that its light causes no discomfort directly or via mirrors/reflecting surfaces.

requirements.text: The daytime running lamps shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 20° outwards and 20° inwards.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed lamp that the apparent surface is visible over 20° outwards and 20° inwards horizontally.

requirements.text: The daytime running lamps shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° upwards and 10° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed lamp that the apparent surface is visible over 10° upwards and 10° downwards.

requirements.text: The daytime running lamps shall be oriented towards the front.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed DRL and verify its reference axis points forwards.

requirements.text: The daytime running lamps shall be switched ON automatically when the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is set in a position which makes it possible for the propulsion system to operate and neither of the following exist: (a) the front fog lamps are switched ON; (b) the headlamps are manually switched ON, except when they are used to give intermittent luminous warnings at short intervals; (c) conditions of Annex 13 for automatic switching ON of dipped-beam headlamps exist.
requirements.test_case: Set the propulsion system to operable position with fog lamps and headlamps OFF in daylight and verify the DRLs switch ON automatically.

requirements.text: The automatic operation of the daytime running lamps shall be resumed as soon as the conditions described in paragraph 6.19.7.2. no longer exist.
requirements.test_case: After manual OFF, remove the 6.19.7.2 conditions (e.g. exceed 15 km/h) and verify the DRLs switch ON automatically.

requirements.text: The daytime running lamp shall switch OFF automatically when the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is set in a position which makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate as well as when either of the following conditions exists: (a) the front fog lamps are switched ON; (b) the headlamps are manually switched ON, except when they are used to give intermittent luminous warnings at short intervals; (c) conditions of Annex 13 for automatic switching ON of dipped-beam headlamps exist.
requirements.test_case: Switch off the propulsion system, switch ON fog lamps or headlamps manually, or create Annex 13 low-light conditions, and verify the DRLs switch OFF automatically.

requirements.text: If a front direction-indicator lamp is not reciprocally incorporated with a daytime running lamp and the distance between the edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction-indicator lamp and the daytime running lamp is equal or less than 40 mm, the electrical connections of the daytime running lamp shall be such that, either (a) the daytime running lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle is switched OFF during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the front direction-indicator lamp; or (b) the luminous intensity of the daytime running lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle is reduced during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the front direction-indicator lamp, to attain not more than 140 cd within the angles of geometric visibility, except that if the luminous intensity of the front direction-indicator lamp in HV is at least 50% higher than the luminous intensity of the daytime running lamp in HV, the daytime running lamp does not need to be switched OFF as required under (a) nor dimmed as required under (b).
requirements.test_case: Measure edge distance of apparent surfaces and, with the direction indicator operating, verify the DRL on that side is OFF or measures not more than 140 cd within the geometric visibility angles (or that the indicator HV intensity is at least 50% above the DRL HV intensity).

requirements.text: If a front direction-indicator lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a daytime running lamp with totally common apparent surfaces, the electrical connections shall be such that the daytime running lamp function on the relevant side of the vehicle is switched OFF during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the front direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.test_case: Activate the direction indicator and verify the DRL function on the same side is OFF throughout both ON and OFF flash cycles.

requirements.text: If a front direction-indicator lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a daytime running lamp with partially common apparent surfaces, the electrical connections of the daytime running lamp shall be such that, either: (a) the whole daytime running lamp function on the relevant side of the vehicle is switched OFF during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of activation of the front direction-indicator lamp; or (b) for category 1a or 1b front direction-indicator lamp the daytime running lamp function on the relevant side of the vehicle is switched OFF for the part of the apparent surface in common with the one of the front direction indicator lamp and the luminous intensity of the part of the apparent surface not in common is reduced during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the front direction-indicator lamp, to attain not more than 140 cd within the angles of geometric visibility.
requirements.test_case: Activate the direction indicator and verify the whole DRL on that side is OFF, or (category 1a/1b) the common part is OFF and the non-common part measures not more than 140 cd within the geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: The number of cornering lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 119, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.
requirements.test_case: Count installed cornering lamps (two) and check approval markings for UN R119 01+ or UN R149 00+.

requirements.text: In width, one cornering lamp shall be located on each side of the vehicle's median longitudinal plane.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation to confirm one cornering lamp each side of the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: The cornering lamps shall be located in length not further than 1,000 mm from the front.
requirements.test_case: Measure longitudinal distance from vehicle front to cornering lamp; pass if not more than 1,000 mm.

requirements.text: The cornering lamps shall be at a height of not less than 250 mm above the ground minimum and not more than 900 mm above the ground maximum.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of apparent surface above ground; pass if between 250 mm and 900 mm.

requirements.text: No point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the cornering lamp shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp.
requirements.test_case: Measure highest point of cornering lamp and dipped-beam headlamp apparent surfaces; pass if cornering lamp is not higher.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the cornering lamps shall be defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 10° upwards and downwards, β = 30° to 60° outwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify by geometric check on vehicle that the apparent surface is visible over α = ±10° and β = 30° to 60° outwards.

requirements.text: The cornering lamps shall be oriented such that the lamps meet the requirements for geometric visibility.
requirements.test_case: Verify installed orientation allows compliance with the geometric visibility angles of paragraph 6.20.5.

requirements.text: The cornering lamps shall be so connected that the cornering lamps cannot be switched ON unless the main-beam headlamps or the dipped-beam headlamps are switched ON at the same time.
requirements.test_case: With headlamps off, attempt to activate cornering lamps; pass if they remain OFF.

requirements.text: The cornering lamp on one side of the vehicle may only be switched ON automatically when the direction-indicators on the same side of the vehicle are switched ON and/or when the steering angle is changed from the straight-ahead position towards the same side of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: verify automatic activation occurs only with same-side indicator or steering towards that side.

requirements.text: The cornering lamp shall be switched OFF automatically when the direction-indicator is switched OFF and/or the steering angle has returned in the straight-ahead position.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: switch off indicator / return steering to straight-ahead and verify cornering lamp switches OFF automatically.

requirements.text: The cornering lamps shall not be switched ON at vehicle speeds above 40 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Drive/simulate above 40 km/h with activation conditions present and verify cornering lamps stay OFF.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency braking logic signal above 50 km/h and verify that all direction-indicator lamps, including those in the bumper, operate simultaneously.

requirements.text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal and measure flash frequency and phase of all lamps; pass if in phase and 3.0 to 5.0 Hz.

requirements.text: The installed manoeuvring lamps (mounted to the side or rear) shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp approval marking and certificate; pass if it shows an approval to UN R23 or UN R148.

requirements.text: The number of side mounted manoeuvring lamps shall be one or two (one per side) on vehicles not exceeding 6m in length.
requirements.test_case: Count the side mounted manoeuvring lamps on the vehicle (≤6 m long); pass if there is one, or two with one per side.

requirements.text: The side mounted manoeuvring lamps shall be at a height above the ground of not more than 1,500mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height of the lamp apparent surface on the vehicle; pass if ≤1,500 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: The manoeuvring lamps shall be oriented downwards, however the requirements of paragraph 6.26.9. shall apply.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp aim; pass if it is directed downwards and the 6.26.9 visibility check is met.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles, the manoeuvring lamps shall be so connected that they cannot be switched ON unless the main-beam headlamps or the dipped-beam headlamps of the motor vehicle are switched ON at the same time.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to activate the manoeuvring lamps with the headlamps off; pass if they stay off unless main or dipped beam is on.

requirements.text: There shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of the manoeuvring lamps, if viewed by an observer moving on the boundary of a zone on a transverse plane 10 m from the front of the vehicle, a transverse plane 10 m from the rear of the vehicle, and two longitudinal planes 10 m from each side of the vehicle; these four planes to extend from 1 m to 3 m above and parallel to the ground as shown in Annex 14.
requirements.test_case: Perform the visual check from the Annex 14 zone (10 m planes, 1-3 m height), or verify by drawing or simulation; pass if the apparent surface is not directly visible.

requirements.text: If the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Activate the answer-back signal (lock/unlock) and measure the flash frequency; pass if it is not more than 2.0 Hz.

requirements.text: The answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices and exterior courtesy lamps where in all these cases, the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line, except that front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps are not permitted to be used.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval markings of the lamps used and measure their intensity in answer-back mode; pass if each lamp is approved, gives not more than 700 cd on or above the HH line, and is not a front fog lamp.

requirements.text: The answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user in proximity to the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Functional test of the activation triggers; pass if the signal is activated only on door locking/unlocking and/or user proximity detection.

requirements.text: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds, this time being defined from the beginning to the end of the signal, irrespective of whether it contains flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.
requirements.test_case: Time the answer-back signal from its start to its end; pass if the duration is not more than 3 s.

requirements.text: For the control of conformity of production, the values measured for the distances of the position of lamps shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured width, height and length distances of the bumper lamps with their individual installation specifications; pass if all within limits.

requirements.text: For the control of conformity of production, the position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: On a production vehicle, measure lamp positions in width, height and length per paragraphs 2.10.2-2.10.4, 2.3.3 and 5.4; check is performed and recorded.

requirements.text: For the control of conformity of production, the values measured for the angles of geometric visibility shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Measure visibility angles of each bumper lamp and compare with its individual specification allowing ±3°; pass if within limits.

requirements.text: For the control of conformity of production, the angles of geometric visibility of lamps shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: On a production vehicle, check geometric visibility angles of the bumper lamps per paragraph 2.10.7; check performed.

requirements.text: For the control of conformity of production, the visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the production vehicle front per paragraph 5.10; pass if no red light from the bumper lighting (signalling or decorative) is visible towards the front.

requirements.text: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.test_case: Operate the bumper lamps and associated tell-tales; pass if switching and tell-tale behaviour conform to paragraphs 5.11-5.14 and the lamp's individual specifications.

requirements.text: For the control of conformity of production, the electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: On a production vehicle, switch on each bumper lamp via the vehicle electrical system; check performed for every lamp.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare lamp presence, number, colour, arrangement and category marking with paragraphs 5.15, 5.16 and individual lamp specifications; pass if all conform.

requirements.text: For the control of conformity of production, the presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the bumper lamps and their approval markings on the production vehicle; check performed.

requirements.text: The test of the vehicle carried out in accordance with the method described in Annex 3 shall be considered satisfactory if all the conditions set out in paragraphs 5.2.1. to 5.2.7. are all satisfied at the same time.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 3 offset deformable barrier test on the vehicle fitted with the front bumper module and verify that all conditions of paragraphs 5.2.1 to 5.2.7 are met simultaneously.

requirements.text: The head performance criterion (HPC) recorded, in accordance with Annex 8, on the dummies in the front outboard seats shall not exceed 1,000.
requirements.test_case: Calculate HPC from the front outboard dummy head acceleration data per Annex 8; pass if HPC ≤ 1,000.

requirements.text: The resultant head acceleration recorded, in accordance with Annex 8, on the dummies in the front outboard seats shall not exceed 80 g for more than 3 ms, calculated cumulatively, excluding rebound movement of the head.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the cumulative duration of resultant head acceleration above 80 g (excluding rebound) for each front outboard dummy; pass if ≤ 3 ms.

requirements.text: The Injury Criteria for the neck (NIC) recorded, in accordance with Annex 8, on the dummies in the front outboard seats in the test of the vehicle carried out in accordance with the method described in Annex 3 shall not exceed the values shown in Figures 1 and 2.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 3 offset frontal test and check the neck tension and shear curves stay below the Figure 1 and 2 limits.

requirements.text: The neck bending moment about the y axis recorded, in accordance with Annex 8, on the dummies in the front outboard seats shall not exceed 57 Nm in extension.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the dummy neck My signal from the Annex 3 test; pass if the extension moment is ≤ 57 Nm.

requirements.text: The Thorax Compression Criterion (ThCC) recorded, in accordance with Annex 8, on the dummies in the front outboard seats shall not exceed 42 mm.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the dummy chest deflection from the Annex 3 test; pass if ThCC is ≤ 42 mm.

requirements.text: The viscous criterion (V * C) for the thorax recorded, in accordance with Annex 8, on the dummies in the front outboard seats shall not exceed 1,0 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Calculate V*C from the thorax deflection of the Annex 3 test; pass if it is ≤ 1,0 m/s.

requirements.text: The femur force criterion (FFC) recorded, in accordance with Annex 8, on the dummies in the front outboard seats shall not exceed the force-time performance criterion shown in Figure 3.
requirements.test_case: Compare the femur compression force-time curves from the Annex 3 test with Figure 3; pass if they are below the limit.

requirements.text: The tibia compression force criterion (TCFC) recorded, in accordance with Annex 8, on the dummies in the front outboard seats shall not exceed 8 kN.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the tibia compression force from the Annex 3 test; pass if it is ≤ 8 kN.

requirements.text: The tibia index (TI) recorded, in accordance with Annex 8, on the dummies in the front outboard seats, measured at the top and bottom of each tibia, shall not exceed 1,3 at either location.
requirements.test_case: Calculate TI at the upper and lower tibia from the Annex 3 test; pass if both values are ≤ 1,3.

requirements.text: The movement of the sliding knee joints recorded, in accordance with Annex 8, on the dummies in the front outboard seats shall not exceed 15 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the knee slider displacement in the Annex 3 test; pass if it is ≤ 15 mm.

requirements.text: Every vehicle approved under this Regulation shall be manufactured so as to conform to the vehicle type approved and satisfy the requirements set forth in paragraphs 5. and 6.
requirements.test_case: Audit production bumper assemblies (beam/cross-member, absorber, fascia) against the approved vehicle-type configuration; pass if they are identical and the vehicle meets paragraphs 5 and 6.

requirements.text: The test vehicle shall be representative of the series production.
requirements.test_case: Compare the bumper module fitted to the test vehicle against series-production drawings/BOM; pass if identical in design and materials.

requirements.text: The vehicle speed at the moment of impact shall be 56 -0/+1 km/h, except that if the test was performed at a higher impact speed and the vehicle met the requirements, the test shall be considered satisfactory.
requirements.test_case: Check the speed trap record of the offset frontal test: impact speed is within 56 -0/+1 km/h, or higher with all requirements met.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of less than 425 mm the requirements of paragraph 5.1.1. shall be applied for the legform test to bumper.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height at each test position; if below 425 mm, verify the flexible lower legform test of paragraph 5.1.1 is applied.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform flexible lower legform impacts per Annex 5 para 1 at all test positions; pass if absolute peak MCL elongation is at most 22 mm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform flexible lower legform impacts per Annex 5 para 1; pass if peak ACL and PCL elongations are each at most 13 mm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform flexible lower legform impacts per Annex 5 para 1; pass if absolute tibia bending moments are at most 340 Nm at all tibia gauges.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm, except that a Contracting Party may restrict application of the relaxation zone requirement in its domestic legislation if it decides that such restriction is appropriate.
requirements.test_case: Check nominated relaxation widths total at most 264 mm and that tibia bending moments in these zones are at most 380 Nm.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position which is greater than, or equal to, 425 mm and less than 500 mm the requirements of either paragraph 5.1.1. or 5.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied for the legform test to bumper.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if 425 mm to <500 mm, verify that the manufacturer-chosen test (5.1.1 or 5.1.2) is applied and documented.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm the requirements of paragraph 5.1.2. shall be applied for the legform test to bumper.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if at least 500 mm, verify the upper legform to bumper test of paragraph 5.1.2 is applied.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
requirements.test_case: Perform upper legform to bumper impacts per Annex 5 para 2; pass if instantaneous sum of impact forces is at most 7.5 kN.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform upper legform to bumper impacts per Annex 5 para 2; pass if bending moment on the impactor is at most 510 Nm.

requirements.text: In the case of a vehicle fitted with an ARHSS, which could change the vehicle height at the front axle more than 20 mm from the nominal for any vehicle speed between 25 and 40 km/h, the provisions of paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. shall, in addition to the normal running condition as specified by the manufacturer for a vehicle speed of 40 km/h, be met for all adjustable vehicle steady heights corresponding to vehicle speeds from 25 up to 40 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Perform legform-to-bumper and headform tests at all adjustable steady heights for 25-40 km/h and verify the limits of 5.1 and 5.2 are met.

requirements.text: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.
requirements.test_case: Verify cut-body content against BOM; pass if complete front bumper module (fascia, absorber, beam, lower stiffener, sensors, brackets) and all contributory front structure are included.

requirements.text: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
requirements.test_case: Check activation state of deployable protection device triggered by bumper pedestrian sensors during each test; pass if correctly activated before/active during impact.

requirements.text: It shall be the responsibility of the manufacturer to show that any devices designed to protect vulnerable road users will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.
requirements.test_case: Review manufacturer evidence (sensor triggering tests/simulation) showing the bumper pedestrian sensing system triggers the device as intended in a pedestrian impact.

requirements.text: Vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position shall require the vehicle to comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.
requirements.test_case: Identify movable bumper components and test/assess pedestrian impact compliance in each fixed position; pass if limits met in every position.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the flexible lower legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure impactor velocity at first contact (gravity-corrected): within 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor tests, the selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the test plan: every lower legform impact point lies within the bumper test area defined per paragraph 2.14.

requirements.text: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report: at least three lower legform tests, one in the middle and one in each outer third of the bumper test area, at worst-case positions.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Check in the upper legform to bumper test records that the impactor velocity measured at bumper contact is within 10.9 to 11.3 m/s.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp drawing/sample; pass if space sufficient for approval marking and other markings is provided.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual check and rub test of markings; pass if legible and not removed.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure approval marking dimension a; pass if ≥ 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking; pass if circle with E and country number is present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking; pass if 4-6 digit sequential number matching the approval number is present.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking layout; pass if sequential number is adjacent to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking; pass if function symbol(s) per Table 1 are present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking; pass if '148R' followed by series digits (e.g. 00/01) is present.

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall consist of a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking of handed lamps; pass if horizontal arrow indicating mounting position is present.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of direction indicators categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12.
requirements.test_case: Inspect arrow on marking; pass if pointing outwards from the vehicle when installed.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect arrow on marking; pass if pointing outwards from the vehicle when installed.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed towards the front of the vehicle in the case of direction indicators of categories 5 and 6 and combined parking lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect arrow on marking; pass if pointing towards the vehicle front when installed.

requirements.text: On lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps, the approval marking shall consist of the additional letter "D" to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking; pass if letter D appears right of the function symbol.

requirements.text: On lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system, the approval marking shall consist of the additional letter "Y" to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking; pass if letter Y appears right of the function symbol.

requirements.text: On lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, the approval marking shall consist of a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking; pass if downward vertical arrow from horizontal segment is present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp; pass if complete approval marking is present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp; pass if applicant's trade name or mark is present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp; pass if light source category marking is present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also bear a marking indicating the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp; pass if LED substitute light source category marking is present.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a legible marking of the rated voltage(s) or voltage range; pass if present.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a legible marking of the rated voltage(s) or voltage range; pass if present.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with a variable luminous intensity control, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a legible marking of the rated voltage(s) or voltage range; pass if present.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with a secondary operating mode, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a legible marking of the rated voltage(s) or voltage range; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each replaceable light source module for the applicant's trade name or mark; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each module for its specific identification code; pass if present.

requirements.text: The specific identification code of the module shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1., followed by additional symbols or characters in case several non-identical light source modules are used.
requirements.test_case: Check the module code begins with 'MD' followed by the approval mark without circle (plus distinguishing characters for non-identical modules); pass if so.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each module for the rated voltage(s) or voltage range marking; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the module identification code; pass if present and matching the module.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the rated voltage(s) or voltage range marking; pass if present.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the external control gear/intensity control for its identification number and manufacturer name; pass if both present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp drawing/sample to verify the approval marking is on a part not separable from the light-emitting transparent part; pass if so.

requirements.text: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed in the bumper on the vehicle, check that the approval marking is visible (directly or with a movable part opened); pass if visible.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: Inspect detachable lens and main body; pass if both carry the approval marking.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each device main body; pass if it bears only the approval marking of its own function(s).

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp; pass if the approval marking and the applicable markings of 3.3.3.2 to 3.3.3.6 are affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the light source module; pass if the 3.3.3.5(a) markings are affixed on the module itself.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number may be affixed and may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that the marking is visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Check the single approval mark is visible with the lamp installed in the bumper; pass if visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Review the design; pass if no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the single approval mark components; pass if not smaller than the smallest minimum size required by the pertinent Regulations.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify by type-approval test report that the lamp meets all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5; pass if all are met.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp against the applicable sections 5 and 6 of UN R48 in force at application; pass if all verifiable provisions are met.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check that the R48 requirements pertinent to the lamp function and to M1 vehicles were verified at lamp type approval where feasible.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Perform vibration/durability testing of the lamp mounted in the bumper and re-measure photometry and colour; pass if operation and prescribed characteristics are retained.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review wiring schematic; verify groups failing together are treated as one light source in failure assessment.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of each light source; pass if minimum intensities per Annex 3 are met (and maxima not exceeded with all on) or a failure tell-tale signal is produced.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp design and parts list; pass if only UN-approved replaceable light sources, light source modules and/or non-replaceable light sources are used.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit the light source in all possible orientations; pass if it can only be fixed in the correct position.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applying.
requirements.test_case: Gauge the holder against the IEC 60061 data sheet for the prescribed category; pass if all characteristics conform.

requirements.text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Perform EMC emission testing at vehicle level; pass if no malfunction of other electric/electronic systems is caused by the lamp.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt fitting in wrong positions and removal without tools; pass if only correct fitting is possible and removal requires tools.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module design for tamper resistance; pass if internal parts cannot be accessed or altered without destruction.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to interchange the module with approved light sources and other modules in the same housing; pass if interchange is impossible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with another of the same identification code and repeat photometric measurements; pass if all photometric requirements are met.

requirements.text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraphs 4.8.1.1. to 4.8.1.10. (Particulars of the methods of measurement to be used are given in Annex 3).
requirements.test_case: Review the test report; pass if measurements were made under the stated conditions and Annex 3 methods.

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check test report; pass if measurements were made with the lamp's own light sources.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined, except that in the case of category 5 and 6 direction indicators, the limits of the light emitting surface shall be determined.
requirements.test_case: Check approval drawings/report; pass if apparent surface (or light emitting surface for category 5/6 indicators) limits are determined.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Verify supply voltage during photometric testing; pass if 13.5 V (12 V system) or as applicable.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement on HV of both samples; intensity ≥ minimum in paragraph 5 table for the lamp function.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum, specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Scan all visible directions of both samples; no measured intensity exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure each grid point of the Annex 3 light distribution figure; each value ≥ minimum × percentage or ≥ the stated intensity value.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity across Annex 2 geometric visibility angles; all values ≥ the paragraph 5 minimum for the function.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate measured light distribution against Annex 3 local variation provisions; no violations.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Confirm photometric test report follows the Annex 8 procedure.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Perform colorimetric measurement within the Annex 3 grid field for the lamp function; chromaticity within the specified limits.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid no sharp variation of colour shall be observed, except that for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Visually/colorimetrically inspect outside the grid field; no sharp colour variation observed.

requirements.text: To check the colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Verify colorimetric tests used the paragraph 4.8 operating conditions (voltage, light sources).

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of front position lamps (A, MA) and front end-outline marker lamps (AM) shall meet the requirements in Table 3.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples; all values within the Table 3 limits.

requirements.text: For front position lamps and front end-outline marker lamps of categories A, MA or AM, the light emitted shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4∙10^0 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), a maximum luminous intensity of 1.40∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 7.0∙10^1 cd for a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and a minimum luminous intensity of 5∙10^-2 cd within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities on reference axis, light distribution grid and geometric visibility angles; min ≥4 cd, max ≤140 cd (≤70 cd if marked D), ≥0.05 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility of front position lamps and front end-outline marker lamps shall be as specified in Table 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity across the Table A2-1 geometric visibility angles; all values ≥0.05 cd.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by front position lamps and front end-outline marker lamps shall be white, except that the lamp identified by symbol MA may be amber.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light; chromaticity within white boundaries (amber permitted for MA).

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of daytime running lamps (RL) shall meet the requirements in Table 6.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples; all values within Table 6 limits.

requirements.text: For daytime running lamps RL, the light emitted shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4.00∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), a maximum luminous intensity of 1.20∙10^3 cd when used as a single lamp or 6.00∙10^2 cd for a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution of Figure A3-II (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and a minimum luminous intensity of 1.0∙10^0 cd within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 6.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities; min ≥400 cd, max ≤1,200 cd (≤600 cd if marked D), ≥1 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: The area of the apparent surface in the direction of the axis of reference of the daytime running lamp shall be not less than 25 cm2 and not more than 200 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the apparent surface area in the reference-axis direction; pass if it is between 25 cm2 and 200 cm2.

requirements.text: The daytime running lamp shall be subjected to the heat resistance test specified in Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 6 heat resistance test on the DRL; pass if Annex 6 acceptance criteria are met.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the daytime running lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the DRL light; pass if within the white colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of direction indicators shall meet the requirements in Table 8 where the minimum luminous intensities shall be fulfilled in the case of direction indicators of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12 in the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Photometrically measure both samples; pass if minimum intensity is met in the reference axis and Table 8 values are satisfied.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of direction indicators shall meet the requirements in Table 8 where the minimum luminous intensities shall be fulfilled in the case of direction indicators of categories 5 and 6 in direction A according to Annex 2.
requirements.test_case: Photometrically measure both samples in direction A per Annex 2; pass if Table 8 minimum intensity is met.

requirements.text: For a direction indicator of category 1, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 1.75∙102 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.20∙103 cd when used as a single lamp and 6.00∙102 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-I and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be 3∙10-1 cd, as specified in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; pass if intensities are within 175-1200 cd (600 cd for D), follow Figure A3-I and are ≥0.3 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: For a direction indicator of category 1a, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 2.50∙102 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.20∙103 cd when used as a single lamp and 6.00∙102 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-I and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be 3∙10-1 cd, as specified in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; pass if intensities are within 250-1200 cd (600 cd for D), follow Figure A3-I and are ≥0.3 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: For a direction indicator of category 1b, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4.00∙102 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.20∙103 cd when used as a single lamp and 6.00∙102 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-I and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be 7∙10-1 cd, as specified in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; pass if intensities are within 400-1200 cd (600 cd for D), follow Figure A3-I and are ≥0.7 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: For a direction indicator of category 5, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6∙10-1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.80∙102 cd when used as a single lamp and 1.40∙102 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as in Table A2-2 and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-2 shall be 6∙10-1 cd, as specified in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; pass if intensities are within 0.6-280 cd (140 cd for D) and ≥0.6 cd within Table A2-2 angles.

requirements.text: For a direction indicator of category 6, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 5.0∙101 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.80∙102 cd when used as a single lamp and 1.40∙102 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", and the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-IV, as specified in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; pass if intensities are within 50-280 cd (140 cd for D) and follow Figure A3-IV.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 where the flash is produced by sequential activation of their light sources, each light source, after its activation, shall remain lit until the end of the ON cycle.
requirements.test_case: Observe the lamp in flashing mode and verify each activated light source stays lit until the end of the ON cycle.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 where the flash is produced by sequential activation of their light sources, the sequence of activation of the light sources shall produce a signal which proceeds in a uniform progressive manner from inboard towards the outboard edge of the light emitting surface.
requirements.test_case: Record the flashing sequence and verify uniform progression from inboard to outboard edge.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 where the flash is produced by sequential activation of their light sources, the signal shall be one signal with no interruption and no vertical oscillations (e.g. not more than one change of direction along the vertical axis).
requirements.test_case: Record the sequence and verify a single uninterrupted signal with at most one vertical direction change.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 where the flash is produced by sequential activation of their light sources, the distance between two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the light emitting surface of the sequential direction indicator shall not exceed 50mm, when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, instead of the values defined in paragraph 5.7.2. of UN Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 5.7.2. of UN Regulation No. 86 or paragraph 5.6.2. of UN Regulation No. 53.
requirements.test_case: Measure gaps between distinct light emitting surface parts perpendicular to the reference axis; each ≤ 50 mm.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 where the flash is produced by sequential activation of their light sources, the variation shall finish no more than 200ms after the beginning of the ON cycle.
requirements.test_case: Measure timing of the sequence with a photodetector; full activation reached ≤ 200 ms after ON cycle start.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 where the flash is produced by sequential activation of their light sources, the ratio of the horizontal to the vertical sides of the circumscribing rectangle shall not be less than 1.7.
requirements.test_case: Measure the circumscribing rectangle; horizontal/vertical ratio ≥ 1.7.

requirements.text: The direction indicator lamps shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Perform the failure tests of paragraph 4.6 and verify compliance.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the direction indicator lamps shall be amber.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates and verify they lie within the amber boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the side marker lamps shall meet the requirements in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples against Table 9 values.

requirements.text: For side marker lamps of category SM1, the minimum luminous intensity in the axis of reference shall be 4.0 cd, the minimum luminous intensity within the standard light distribution of Figure A3-VII shall be 0.6 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 25.0 cd, and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-3 shall be 0.6 cd, as specified in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities: axis ≥ 4.0 cd, distribution points ≥ 0.6 cd, max ≤ 25 cd, geometric visibility field ≥ 0.6 cd.

requirements.text: For side marker lamps of category SM2, the minimum luminous intensity in the axis of reference shall be 0.6 cd, the minimum luminous intensity within the standard light distribution of Figure A3-VIII shall be 0.6 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 25.0 cd, and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-3 shall be 0.6 cd, as specified in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities: axis ≥ 0.6 cd, distribution points ≥ 0.6 cd, max ≤ 25 cd, geometric visibility field ≥ 0.6 cd.

requirements.text: The side marker lamps shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Perform the failure tests of paragraph 4.6 and verify compliance.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the side marker lamps shall be amber, except that it can be red, if the rearmost side marker lamp is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp, or is grouped with or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates and verify they lie within the amber boundaries.

requirements.text: Lamps shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Compare production side signalling lamps with the approved type documentation and samples; pass if no deviations from the approved type are found.

requirements.text: For verification of the compliance of the lamps with the requirements set forth in paragraph 5., the minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 4 shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Audit the manufacturer's CoP control procedures against Annex 4; pass if all minimum requirements are implemented.

requirements.text: For verification of the compliance of the lamps with the requirements set forth in paragraph 5., the minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 5 shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Check that inspector sampling of production lamps follows Annex 5; pass if sampled lamps meet the Annex 5 criteria.

requirements.text: When the compliance of the lamps with the requirements set forth in paragraph 5. is verified, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometrically measure production lamps; pass if no value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the prescribed values.

requirements.text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3 the measured values of the lamps shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12.
requirements.test_case: Measure production lamps at the field points of Annexes 2 and 3; pass if measured values are not below the Table 12 equivalents.

requirements.text: For the front direction indicator (1, 1a, 1b), the angles of geometric visibility shall be minimum horizontal angles (inboard / outboard) of 45°/80° (20°/80°, reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm) and minimum vertical angles (above / below) of 15°/15° (15°/5° for lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm) as specified in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric check that the lamp's light-emitting surface is unobstructed and meets the required intensities over 45° inboard/80° outboard horizontally and 15°/15° vertically (reduced angles where H-plane <750 mm).
