requirements.text: For the side direction indicators (5), the angles of geometric visibility shall be horizontal angles (A/B) of 5°/55°, the horizontal angles applying to direction A, and minimum vertical angles (above / below) of 15°/15° (15°/5° reduced angles used for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm) as specified in Table A2-2.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric verification of light emission over 5°/55° horizontally (direction A) and 15°/15° (or 15°/5°) vertically.

requirements.text: For the front/rear position lamp (A, R1, R2), the angles of geometric visibility shall be minimum horizontal angles (inboard / outboard) of 45°/80° (20°/80°, reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm) and minimum vertical angles (above / below) of 15°/15° (15°/5° for lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm; 5°/15° for optional lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm) as specified in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric verification of light emission over 45° inboard/80° outboard horizontally and 15°/15° vertically, with reduced angles where H-plane <750 mm.

requirements.text: For the daytime running lamps (RL), the angles of geometric visibility shall be minimum horizontal angles (inboard / outboard) of 20°/20° and minimum vertical angles (above / below) of 10°/5° as specified in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric verification of light emission over 20°/20° horizontally and 10° above/5° below vertically.

requirements.text: For the side marker lamp (SM1), the angles of geometric visibility shall be minimum horizontal angles (A/B) of 45°/45° and minimum vertical angles (above / below) of 10°/10° (10°/5° reduced angles used for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm) as specified in Table A2-3.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric verification of light emission over 45°/45° horizontally and 10°/10° (or 10°/5°) vertically.

requirements.text: For the side marker lamp (SM2), the angles of geometric visibility shall be minimum horizontal angles (A/B) of 30°/30° and minimum vertical angles (above / below) of 10°/10° (10°/5° reduced angles used for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm) as specified in Table A2-3.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric verification of light emission over 30°/30° horizontally and 10°/10° (or 10°/5°) vertically.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the minimum intensities given in Figures A3-I to A3-XV for the various directions of measurement as a percentage of the minimum intensities required shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits, except that in the case where one of the following lamps is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards: (a) Front and rear direction indicators lamps; (b) Front and rear position lamps; (c) Front and rear end-outline marker lamps; (d) Parking lamps; (e) Stop lamps of category S1, S2 and MS; (f) Side marker lamps.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement: compute each grid-point minimum as the rounded-down (3 significant digits) percentage of the table minimum and check measured values meet it, limiting downward check to 5° if mounting height ≤ 750 mm.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Scan intensity between grid lines with a goniophotometer and verify no direction falls below the lowest surrounding grid-point minimum percentage.

requirements.text: The front and rear position lamps, parking lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, stop lamps (S1, S2 and MS) and direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c, 12 shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8) given in Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at the Figure A3-I grid points and verify each meets the stated percentage of the applicable table minimum.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Compare production lamp dimensions and mechanical features with the approved type; pass if deviations stay within inevitable manufacturing deviations and the Regulation's requirements.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested, when testing photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometrically test a randomly chosen production lamp per paragraph 4.8; pass if results meet the conformity criteria.

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source, if results of the photometric test of a lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.
requirements.test_case: If the first photometric COP test fails, repeat with another standard light source; pass if the repeated test meets the requirements.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the mass-produced lamps shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of production lamps under paragraph 4.9 conditions; pass if coordinates lie within the specified colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
requirements.test_case: Inspect and measure randomly chosen production lamps against the approved drawings; pass if mechanical and geometric differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performance, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random, no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometrically test a randomly chosen production lamp per paragraph 4.8; pass if no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performance, in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.
requirements.test_case: If a lamp with replaceable light source fails the photometric CoP test, repeat the test with another standard light source and check compliance with paragraph 6.1.3 values.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of a production lamp under the conditions of paragraph 4.9; pass if within the prescribed colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The daytime running lamp shall be subjected to a one-hour test of continuous operation following a warm-up period of 20 minutes.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp for a 20-minute warm-up followed by 60 minutes of continuous operation and record the durations.

requirements.text: The ambient temperature for the heat resistance test of the daytime running lamp shall be 23 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Log the ambient temperature throughout the heat test and confirm it stays within 18 °C to 28 °C.

requirements.text: For daytime running lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources (filament light sources and other), the heat resistance test shall be made with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with paragraph 5.4.5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test is run on the lamp with its own non-replaceable light sources under the paragraph 5.4.5 conditions.

requirements.text: After the daytime running lamp has been stabilized at the ambient temperature following the heat resistance test, no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour modification shall be perceptible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the lamp after stabilisation; pass if no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour change is visible.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the intensity of light of the daytime running lamp shall be measured according to paragraph 5 of this Regulation and the values shall reach at least 90 per cent of the values obtained before the heat resistance test on the same lamp.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometric values before and after the heat test; pass if post-test values are at least 90 per cent of pre-test values.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp until photometric stability and measure luminous intensities at all test points; pass if all values lie within the minimum and maximum limits.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, for all lamps other than reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensities after 1 min and after 30 min (or after photometric stability); pass if all values at every test point lie within the minimum and maximum limits.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, operation of direction indicator lamps shall be done in flashing mode (f = 1.5 Hz, duty factor 50 per cent).
requirements.test_case: Verify the test set-up operates the direction indicator at 1.5 Hz with 50 per cent duty factor during the 1 min and 30 min/stability measurements.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the lamp (function) shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity distribution at the time after switch ON listed in Table A8-1 for the lamp function; pass if the values comply with the intensity requirements.

requirements.text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm paragraph 1.2 measurements (1 min and 30 min/stability) are compliant; pass if so.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of less than 425 mm the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1. shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height in normal ride attitude; if below 425 mm, confirm the lower legform test of paragraph 4.1.1. is applied.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height which is greater than, or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm the requirements of either paragraph 4.1.1. or 4.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if between 425 mm and 500 mm, confirm the manufacturer-chosen legform test (4.1.1. or 4.1.2.) is applied.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm the requirements of paragraph 4.1.2. shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if 500 mm or more, confirm the upper legform test of paragraph 4.1.2. is applied.

requirements.text: To verify compliance of the lower legform to bumper with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.1. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Review test report to confirm the FlexPLI impactor per 6.3.1.1. and procedure per 7.1.1. were used.

requirements.text: To verify compliance of the upper legform to bumper with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.2., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.2. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.2. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Review test report to confirm the upper legform impactor per 6.3.1.2. and procedure per 7.1.2. were used.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform FlexPLI impacts per 7.1.1. across the bumper test area; pass if peak |MCL elongation| ≤ 22 mm at every test point.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform FlexPLI impacts per 7.1.1.; pass if peak ACL and PCL elongations are each ≤ 13 mm at every test point.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform FlexPLI impacts per 7.1.1.; pass if |tibia bending moment| ≤ 340 Nm at all tibia segments and test points outside nominated relaxation widths.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm, except that a Contracting Party may restrict application of the relaxation zone requirement in its domestic legislation if it decides that such restriction is appropriate.
requirements.test_case: Check nominated relaxation widths total ≤ 264 mm and that |tibia bending moment| ≤ 380 Nm at test points within them.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
requirements.test_case: Perform upper legform impacts per 7.1.2.; pass if the instantaneous sum of impact forces ≤ 7.5 kN throughout the impact.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform upper legform impacts per 7.1.2.; pass if the measured bending moment on the impactor ≤ 510 Nm.

requirements.text: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.
requirements.test_case: Compare the cut-body content with the vehicle front structure BOM and confirm the complete bumper module (fascia, absorber, beam, lower stiffener, sensors) and other front components are included.

requirements.text: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
requirements.test_case: Verify before/during the test that the protective devices linked to the pedestrian impact sensors are correctly activated or active.

requirements.text: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.
requirements.test_case: Identify movable bumper components and confirm the pedestrian tests are passed with the components in each fixed shape or position.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.test_case: Check test records: the time between removal of the impactor from controlled storage and completion of each test is no more than 2 hours.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, the selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.
requirements.test_case: Review the bumper marking and test plan: all selected target points lie within the defined bumper test area.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, the direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the propulsion set-up and high-speed video: the impact velocity vector is horizontal and parallel to the vehicle longitudinal vertical plane.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, the tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ± 2° at the time of first contact.
requirements.test_case: Measure velocity vector direction at first contact from video/tracking data: deviation is within ± 2° in both planes.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, the axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane, with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ± 2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure impactor roll and pitch at first contact: both within ± 2° of vertical.

requirements.text: The bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be 75 mm above the ground reference plane at the time of the first contact with the bumper (see Figure 21), with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure impactor bottom height at first contact with the bumper: 75 ± 10 mm above ground reference plane.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in 'free flight' at the moment of impact.
requirements.test_case: Verify by video that the impactor is detached from the propulsion system at the moment of impact.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the lower legform impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ± 5° (see Figure 20).
requirements.test_case: Measure impactor yaw at first contact: within ± 5° of intended orientation.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the centre line of the lower legform impactor shall be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact location.
requirements.test_case: Compare impact mark/video with target point: impactor centre line within ± 10 mm.

requirements.text: During contact between the lower legform impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect video: impactor touches only vehicle parts during contact phase.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the lower legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure impact velocity at bumper contact: 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, the selected target points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 3.10.
requirements.test_case: Mark the bumper test area per paragraph 3.10 on the vehicle and verify that every selected upper legform target point lies within it.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, the direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact, with a tolerance to this direction of ± 2°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor trajectory and legform axis at first contact and verify they are parallel to the vehicle longitudinal axis and vertical within ± 2°.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, at the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a + 10 mm tolerance.
requirements.test_case: Determine the upper and lower bumper reference lines at the impact location and verify from high-speed video that the impactor centre line at first contact is at their midpoint within + 10 mm.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, at the time of first contact the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.
requirements.test_case: Compare the lateral position of the impactor vertical centre line at first contact with the marked impact location and verify the deviation is within ± 10 mm.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure the upper legform impactor velocity at bumper contact and verify it is 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower-legform-to-bumper test, tibia bending moments shall not exceed ±15 Nm during the 30 ms immediately before impact.
In the flexible lower-legform-to-bumper test, the impactor shall have its intended orientation about the vertical axis at first contact, within a yaw angle tolerance of ±5°.
The effective mass of the impactor shall be equal to the mass corresponding to the "unladen weight" of the vehicle to be tested.
requirements.test_case: Compare the impactor effective mass with the vehicle unladen weight and confirm they are equal.

requirements.text: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the manufacturer's stated recovery time is respected between impacts.

requirements.text: The selected lower legform test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral spacing between selected lower legform test points: each spacing is at least 84 mm.

requirements.text: The lower legform to bumper tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.
requirements.test_case: Compare the selected test points with the bumper structure layout (absorber, stiffener, sensor and bracket locations): each differing structure type is tested.

requirements.text: Where upper-legform-to-bumper testing applies based on lower bumper height, a minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report: at least three upper legform tests, one in the middle and each outer third, at worst-case positions.

requirements.text: Where upper-legform-to-bumper testing applies based on lower bumper height, the upper legform to bumper tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.
requirements.test_case: Compare selected upper legform test points with the bumper structure layout: each differing structure type is tested.

requirements.text: Where upper-legform-to-bumper testing applies based on lower bumper height, the selected upper legform measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral spacing between upper legform measuring points: each at least 84 mm.
